name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Akvan weakened and crossed the Odisha–Andhra coast near Gopalpur early on 20 Nov; GDACS green
state: Cyclone Akvan weakened to a cyclonic storm early on 20 Nov and crossed the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast near Gopalpur between 07:30 and 08:30 local time, with IMD giving winds of 70–80 km/h gusting to 90 km/h (IndToday, 20 Nov). Odisha had evacuated about 299,000 people by 19 Nov; no deaths had been reported. GDACS rates Akvan and Cyclone Xavier near the Cook Islands green, so with landfall over the level returns to Normal.
for_you: People in coastal Odisha and Andhra Pradesh should follow IMD warnings and state disaster authority instructions as rain continues. Travellers should check FCDO travel advice and expect rail disruption on the east coast.

sources.title: IndToday — Cyclone Akvan weakens, crosses Odisha coast near Gopalpur

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
